meta.note: Variables are any type of value that can be reused throughout the comic.

(Optional) The thumbnail image that appears when a link to this page is shared. By default, the first comic panel image is shown (if it exists). Otherwise, this will override it.

Choose to have the comic live at the root of your domain (`yourwebsite.com`) instead of in a subfolder (`yourwebsite.com/yourcomic`). This is useful if you plan to only have one comic on the website. Having multiple comics will disable this setting.
